About me

I'm a junior at NC State studying Computer Science and Business Analytics, with a minor in Data Science. I love exploring the intersection of business and computer science to find solutions for real-life problems, and I want to use everything I learn to contribute to social good, optimizing targeted assistance for communities across the nation.

How I got into code

In middle school, I wanted a platform to sell the arts and crafts I made, and I didn't want to pay for a website editor, so I figured, how hard could it be to just code one myself? I fell in love with it because I realized I could bring art into it too, and that coding could actually be a creative field.

How I got to NC State

NC State wasn't even my first choice. I started at UNC Charlotte and didn't picture myself ending up here at all. But once I transferred, I fell in love with the department, the people, and the opportunities I didn't expect to find. Now I get to tell incoming and transfer students the same thing someone once had to tell me: this place might surprise you.

Engineering Visibility Dashboard

A full-stack, AI-assisted tool that helps product managers see what an engineering team is working on, what it committed to, and whether it delivered. I spotted the gap from repeated feedback across engineering and PM teams, then built it from zero.

Grain protein research

At Kansas State University, I built multi-output regression models across 5 grain types to predict region-specific protein content. The goal is AI-driven nutritional optimization across grain supply chains. I used pandas, NumPy, and Seaborn to find which features matter most.

I make study and career content. Brands noticed.

It started as a way to hold myself accountable. It turned into a community of students, and I use it to share what I'm learning and motivate people, including how to grow and adapt in a world of AI.

~8Kfollowers on TikTok (@winglvr13)
2.7M+likes on study vlogs and career tips
12+brand partnerships delivered

Why content?

Because there's a different kind of pride that comes from putting something out into the world and having it actually reach someone. I first started posting as a way to hold myself accountable. I was getting tired of studying by myself and thought vlogging it might help.

What I didn't expect was how much fun and community I'd find in it. That's what turned into me sharing the things that were actually helping me succeed, from study tips to internship advice to just getting through a hard week. Hearing that any of it helped someone else means everything to me.

These days I'm also learning how to grow and adapt in a world of AI, and I want to share that too. If I can help someone feel more motivated while they figure it out, that's the goal.
